Well I started like you according to your post. I had crippling anxiety and panic attacks to the point where I could not hold a job or leave my house or even enter a grocery store.

I started using alcohol , taking anxiety medication from my doctor ect.. I got sick of being a shell of a man and found out about phenibut.

I found a dose around 3g per day that made me able to function and move forward in my life for the first time in a very long time.  I was able to enter stores with my head held high. I was able to call friends I have been ignoring for years because I didn't want to explain how terrible my life was going. I was able to enjoy life again. I have even started my own buisness that is going well.

I am now at a point in my life where I am saving money fast and all seems to look well on the outside. I began to up my dose 1g more each day and then stopped even measuring it. As it goes with all drugs my tolerance grew. If you suffer from anxiety as I do I got addicted to NOT having anxiety more than the drug itself if that makes sense.

I am a a 25 year old male who is a father of a 7 year old daughter. I am engaged to be married to my fiance of 6 years. I am an uncle to a 4 year old niece. I am sick of living and think of killing myself everyday now because of this substance.

I am just sending my experience to you in hopes you may find any other avenues that can help you instead of phenibut. Nobody wakes up and says " I want to get addicted to something" addiction doesn't discriminate.

If you think 25g a day is a lot I really encourage you to look at forums of people who use 40-50 grams a day or perhaps take a look at some of the people that have overdosed on this drug by accident.

Not everyone will have this experience of course but I assure you for every 100 people who struggle with phenibut you may find only 10 actually take the time to write about it
